name: Birrieria
notes: Own site (birrieria.website), fully priced, 53 items, address confirmed exactly (1794 Newton Ave, San Diego, CA 92113). The page's section-divider <h2> banners are ambiguous about which item block they open vs. close (several appear back-to-back with zero items between two of them, e.g. 'Dessert' immediately followed by 'Birria' around the same 13-item block of tacos/quesabirria/tostadas/consome) -- section names below are a content-based judgment call (e.g. labeling that block 'Birria' rather than the literal leading header 'Dessert', since the items are birria tacos and consome, not desserts), not a price judgment; every name and price is transcribed exactly as shown. 'Flan $3.00' appears twice in the raw page (once inside the Birria block, once inside Extras) and both occurrences are kept, not merged/deduped, since that is what the site literally lists twice. No markup pattern (small direct-order prices, no delivery surcharge signature). None of the prices were inferred, divided, or truncated.

Extra Item pricing for pizza toppings (Small $4.25 / Large $4.50 / Chicken $9.00) recorded as add-on rows. Full page-by-page section coverage reached: Drinks, Appetizers, Salads, Pizza, Side Dressings, Pasta Specialties, Specialties of the House, Pasta, Ravioli, Lasagna, Gluten Free Pasta, Side Orders, Sandwiches, Desserts, Beverages (soft + alcohol).
